subject: Re: ODA Order Form - Pricing ladder, min commit & tax routing
body:
From: Aisha Karim <aisha@olive-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Michael Lowe <m.lowe@lowe-legal.com>
Date: 2027-11-20 09:12 PST
Subject: ODA Order Form - initial redline requests

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. Attaching our suggested redlines to the Order Form (see ODA_OrderForm_v3_redlined.pdf and pricing attachment). A few highlights we want to confirm before legal does a final pass:

- Pricing ladder: we'd like the Q1 ramp (Tier 1) to kick in at 100k tokens/month rather than 200k. That materially impacts our forecast.
- Minimum commit: because we're piloting, can we move from an annual commit to a 6-month minimum with a pro-rata true-up?
- Net terms: our finance team prefers Net 60 for initial purchases.
- Tax handling: we are VAT-registered in the EU and will provide a VAT certificate; we expect Redwood to issue invoices net of VAT when a valid EU VAT ID is supplied.

Can your team confirm which items are commercial vs. legal changes so we can expedite? Attaching tax cert.

Thanks,
Aisha

--
Aisha Karim
Head of Procurement, Olive Data Analytics
aisha@olive-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

----

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Aisha Karim <aisha@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Michael Lowe <m.lowe@lowe-legal.com>
Date: 2027-11-20 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: ODA Order Form - initial redline requests

Aisha — thanks for the redlines and the quick turnaround. Looping in Kimberly from Legal and Karthik who owns commercial.

Quick callouts:
- Pricing ladder: Karthik, we can propose a temporary Tier 1 at 100k tokens/month for the first 3 billing months as a ramp, then revert to the standard ladder unless ODA elects to keep it. Is that acceptable?
- Minimum commit: Karthik — 6-month minimum is reasonable for a pilot; we typically structure as a pre-paid commitment or monthly invoice with an end-of-term reconciliation. Which do you prefer?
- Net terms: Jordan for sales — Net 60 is outside standard policy. We can agree Net 45 for the pilot, contingent on credit approval.
- Tax: Kimberly — please confirm process for EU VAT IDs and invoicing net of VAT.

Next steps: Kimberly to provide redline language for the tax clause and invoice entity routing; Karthik to confirm the ramp pricing language. I will ask ODA to confirm billing entity and PO path so we can circulate an updated Order Form.

Jordan

--

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>, Aisha Karim <aisha@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Michael Lowe <m.lowe@lowe-legal.com>
Date: 2027-11-20 11:40 PST
Subject: Re: ODA Order Form - tax & entity invoice routing language

Hi all,

I've reviewed Aisha's redlines and attached a short legal markup (see ODA_OrderForm_v3_redlined.pdf). Key legal positions and suggested language below — these are narrow, aimed at keeping Redwood operationally aligned while addressing ODA's needs:

1) Tax clause (proposed):
"Taxes: All fees are exclusive of taxes. Customer shall be responsible for any applicable sales, use or value-added taxes (VAT/GST), except for Redwood's U.S. income taxes. If Customer provides a valid VAT registration number and tax exemption documentation prior to invoicing, Redwood will issue invoices net of VAT where permitted by law. Any withholding tax obligations shall be borne by Customer, who shall provide evidence of withholding tax payments where required."

2) Invoice Entity & PO routing (proposed):
"Invoices shall be issued to the entity specified in the Order Form (Billing Entity). Customer shall confirm the Billing Entity and provide a PO number where required. Redwood reserves the right to charge applicable taxes to the Billing Entity stated in the Order Form. For multi-entity purchases, Customer will indicate the split in an attachment to the Order Form."

3) Net terms / credit:
"Standard payment terms are Net 45. For extended terms beyond Net 45, such as Net 60, Customer must complete Redwood's credit application and provide an approved credit limit. Any extended term is subject to Redwood's approval and may require additional security (e.g., prepayment, letter of credit)."

4) Minimum commitment / ramp:
"For pilot customers electing a 6-month minimum, fees will be invoiced monthly with an end-of-term reconciliation. If actual usage is below the agreed minimum, Customer shall pay the shortfall amount as an adjustment on the final invoice of the term."

Operational asks for ODA: please confirm the Billing Entity legal name, billing address, and whether payments will be routed via PO or via centralized treasury. If ODA will be invoiced outside the US (EU entity), please attach VAT certificate.

If any of this is acceptable, Jordan/Karthik and I will produce an updated Order Form and pricing schedule.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.example.com

Attachment: ODA_OrderForm_v3_redlined.pdf

----

From: Aisha Karim <aisha@olive-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Michael Lowe <m.lowe@lowe-legal.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-11-22 08:25 PST
Subject: Re: ODA Order Form - pricing ladder, min commit & tax routing

Thanks Kimberly — that language looks good generally. Clarifications from our side: 

- Billing Entity: Olive Data Analytics, Inc. (US entity) will be the billing entity for the pilot. For the EU pilot nodes, we may request invoices to our EU subsidiary; we will flag that separately.
- VAT: we will provide a current VAT cert for the EU entity by Thursday.
- Net terms: finance confirms they can support Net 45 if Redwood's credit application is approved — we will start the application this week.
- Minimum commit: we want the 6-month minimum to have a pro-rata true-up and the option to convert the remainder into pre-paid credits if we expand. Could you include that optional conversion language?

Also attached is a short pricing workbook with the ramp tier numbers we tested.

Best,
Aisha

Attachment: ODA_Tax_Cert_2027.pdf; OrderForm_Attachment_A_pricing.xlsx

----

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Aisha Karim <aisha@olive-analytics.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-11-22 16:50 PST
Subject: Re: ODA Order Form - final steps for updated Order Form

Appreciate the confirmations, Aisha. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) Kimberly will add the optional conversion clause for unused commit amounts into pre-paid credits and circulate a clean Order Form + redline.
2) Karthik will incorporate the 3-month ramp at 100k tokens/month and include the pricing workbook as Attachment A.
3) Jordan (me) will submit the credit application for ODA once Aisha confirms the point of contact — feel free to loop finance directly.
4) Once Redwood has the VAT certificate and Billing Entity confirmed, we will issue invoices net of VAT for EU invoices where allowed.

Target timeline: Kimberly & Karthik to circulate updated Order Form (clean + redline) by end of day Friday 2027-11-26. If the credit application completes and legal signs off, we aim to have countersigned documents and initial invoice issued in early December.

If that's good on your side, I'll track and we can set a 30-minute sync if anything stalls.

Jordan
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
